normalized.result: Yes, this feels just as safe as archiving one at a time. Selecting all four and archiving took them out of the Cooking view together, and then Undo brought every one of them back — the pasta guide, the recipes, grandma's sauce, and the sourdough starters — each with its own labels intact, exactly as they were. So doing a batch isn't scarier than doing one; if I sweep too much away by mistake, one tap puts it all back. That's the reassurance I'd want before trusting bulk actions. What's next?
